definitions.explanation: The amount that can be picked up between the thumb and two fingers, a standard rough measure in Japanese recipes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ひとつまみ⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
⟦{仕上|しあ}げ→仕上げ：11519_shiage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ひとつまみ⟦{加|くわ}えます→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
examples.english: Finish by adding a pinch of sugar.

examples.japanese: ⟦パスタ→パスタ：06768_pasuta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ゆでるとき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ひとつまみ⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When you boil pasta, adding a pinch of salt to the water makes it taste better.

notes:
From ひと (one) + ⟦つまみ→つまみ：16139_tsumami⟧ (a pinch, from ⟦つまむ→つまむ：10374_tsumamu⟧, to pinch). Also written {一|ひと}つまみ. In recipes it comes after the ingredient with no particle: ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ひとつまみ (a pinch of salt).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ひとつまみ: a pinch of salt
- ひとつまみ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧: a pinch of sugar
- ⟦ほんの→ほんの：22755_honno⟧ひとつまみ: just a tiny pinch

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{少々|しょうしょう}→少々：03232_shoushou⟧: a little; in recipes, by convention slightly less than ひとつまみ, what two fingers pick up (⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦{少々|しょうしょう}→少々：03232_shoushou⟧)
- ⟦{一握|ひとにぎ}り→一握り：18544_hitonigiri⟧: a handful; also figuratively 'a small minority' (⟦{一握|ひとにぎ}り→一握り：18544_hitonigiri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧)
